item.title: Surge in displacement following fighting in southwest Yemen
item.description: At least 46,000 people have been displaced since renewed fighting last week between Houthi rebels and pro-government forces in southwestern Yemen, the International Organization for Migration (IOM) reported on Friday.

item.title: Terrorist propaganda is outpacing global efforts to stop it, UN report finds
item.description: Terrorist groups are recruiting, raising money and even planning operations through propaganda that is now “embedded” in every stage of their work, a new UN report warns – and governments are struggling to keep pace.

item.title: Security Council LIVE: Ambassadors mark 9/11 with counter-terrorism push on AI and drones
item.description: The Security Council meets top of the hour to mark 25 years since the 9/11 attacks, with a briefing on counter-terrorism as ambassadors take stock of a threat that has morphed dramatically since resolution 1373 built the council's counter-terrorism machinery in 2001. Briefers are expected to zero in on militants' growing use of artificial intelligence, drones and encrypted platforms for recruitment and attack planning. Members are also set to adopt a presidential statement – the Council's first on terrorism in five years – after reportedly tense talks over references to specific groups and new tech language.
